title: Interprocess Data Write
text: 使用处理器间数据写入向另一个处理器发送消息，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Channels number} 指定通道号；{Enable simulation port} 为模块启用外设仿真端口、{Circular FIFO depth} 指定存储缓冲区数量、{Trigger interrupt on receiving core} 以触发中断、{Participating cores} 指定处理器的参与内核 The options vary based on the hardware board you，按实例取值。

params.name: Enable simulation port
params.values: 为模块启用外设仿真端口 on (default) | off

params.name: Circular FIFO depth
params.values: 存储缓冲区数量 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Trigger interrupt on receiving core
params.values: 选择以触发中断 off (default) | on

params.name: Participating cores
params.values: 选择处理器的参与内核 The options vary based on the hardware board you select
